=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~247-255 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The `codex-agent` job name checks `needs.gate.outputs.claude_branch_review`, but the gate job only sets an environment variable, so the claude-branch suffix can never appear.
  WHY: All three reviewers identified the same runtime bug: downstream `needs.<job>.outputs` cannot read a value that was only written to job-local env, so the expression will always fall back to the default name.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~247-255 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Renaming the displayed check name for claude branches may conflict with branch protection rules that expect the original status check name.
  WHY: Two reviewers raised this as a compatibility risk, while one reviewer said it is not a concern if protections key off the job ID; it only matters if matching is done on the displayed name.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~247-255 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `codex-agent` job name references `needs.gate.outputs.claude_branch_review`, but the gate job only exports `CLAUDE_BRANCH_REVIEW_MODE` as an environment variable.
  WHY: Because env vars do not populate `needs.<job>.outputs`, the expression will always evaluate falsy and the claude-branch suffix will never be shown.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~247-255 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The new displayed check name may interact badly with branch protection rules that expect the exact `codex-agent` check name.
  WHY: If protections match on the visible check name, the suffixed variant could fail to satisfy them and block merges.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:Line or code reference: The `codex-agent` job name conditional and the `gate` job outputs | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The job name conditional reads `needs.gate.outputs.claude_branch_review`, but the gate job only exports `CLAUDE_BRANCH_REVIEW_MODE` as an environment variable, not a job output.
  WHY: In GitHub Actions, env vars set in a job are not available through `needs.<job>.outputs`, so the suffix will never appear even on `claude/**` branches.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:lines ~247-255 per PR description | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `name:` expression checks `needs.gate.outputs.claude_branch_review`, but the gate job only sets `CLAUDE_BRANCH_REVIEW_MODE=true` as an environment variable.
  WHY: Environment variables written via `$GITHUB_ENV` do not populate `needs.<job>.outputs`, so the expression will always fall back to `codex-agent`.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~247-255 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Changing the displayed check name on claude branches may conflict with branch protection rules that expect `review / codex-agent`.
  WHY: If branch protection matches the visible check name, the suffixed display name could fail required-status checks.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
